title: speceval — SOTA Benchmark for Agentic Specification Generation
body: ## Summary Production-grade evaluation framework for benchmarking agentic specification generation pipelines. Tailored to the ifactorial 4-stage architecture (Ingest → Align → Question → Generate) but architecture-agnostic by design. **Evaluation engine:** - **8 quality dimensions** (D1–D8): Structural Completeness, Requirement Precision, Legacy Fidelity, Gap Coverage, Traceability, Consistency, Decision Readiness, Uncertainty Transparency - **Tier 1 — 5 deterministic evaluators** (<1s, CI-gate) covering D1, D2, D5, D6, D8 - **Tier 2 — LLM-as-judge** with multi-judge ensemble, Cohen's κ inter-judge reliability, pairwise A/B comparison - **I/O contract**: `EvalInput` (sources + template + goals + generated spec) → `EvalReport` (dimension scores + composite + diagnostics) **Meta-evaluation (RALPH loops):** - 10 mutation operators (remove sections, vague requirements, hallucinate sources, add contradictions, etc.) - 100% mutation kill rate after 3 iterations (60% → 80% → 100%) - Blind spots fixed: structural quadratic penalty + critical sections, cross-requirement semantic contradiction detector **Testing:** 51 passing tests + 6 synthetic fixtures (1 good + 5 injected-defect specs) **Research report:** [prd-modernization-benchmark-report.md](prd-modernization-benchmark-report.md) — 30+ citations, 5 evaluation categories surveyed Quick start: `uv sync --all-extras && uv run pytest tests/ -v` ## Review & Testing Checklist for Human - [ ] Run `uv sync --all-extras && uv run pytest tests/ -v` — verify 51 tests pass - [ ] Run `uv run python -m speceval.meta.run_ralph` — verify 100% kill rate (10/10 mutations caught) - [ ] Review dimension weights in `speceval/schema.py` `DEFAULT_WEIGHTS` — tune to your priorities (D3 Legacy Fidelity has highest weight at 0.20) - [ ] Review pass thresholds in `speceval/schema.py` `PASS_THRESHOLDS` — adjust if some dimensions should be more/less strict - [ ] To test with real LLM judges: set up OpenAI/Anthropic API keys and use real providers instead of `MockProvider` in Tier 2 ### Notes - Tier 2 LLM-as-judge currently uses `MockProvider` (deterministic mock responses) since no API keys are configured. Swap to `OpenAIProvider`/`AnthropicProvider` when ready. - The `program.md` file documents the autoresearch-style experiment loop for future RALPH iterations. - Research report (`prd-modernization-benchmark-report.md`) was created in the first commit; eval code was added in this commit. Link to Devin session: https://app.devin.ai/sessions/5dd981ca632641778b9ae1b036a59a82 Requested by: @desmondzee ---
